```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, fig.align = "center")
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
# Anything a person typed -- a project name, a layer tag, a group
# label, a feature id -- is inserted into markdown here, and markdown
# passes raw HTML through. Escaped once, at the seam, so a name that
# carries "<script>" reads as that text rather than running as it.
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
esc_df <- function(df) {
  for (nm in names(df)) {
    if (is.character(df[[nm]]) || is.factor(df[[nm]])) {
      df[[nm]] <- esc(as.character(df[[nm]]))
    }
  }
  names(df) <- esc(names(df))
  df
}
# p-values as a reader expects them: 3 significant digits, and "< 1e-300"
# rather than 0.
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  out <- ifelse(is.na(p), "", formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "g"))
  out[!is.na(p) & p < 1e-300] <- "< 1e-300"
  out
}
fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
and_list <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (length(x) <= 1L) return(x)
  paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
}
scale_label <- function(a) {
  switch(a %||% "",
         raw_intensity = "raw (linear) intensities",
         normalized_intensity = "log2 intensities",
         imputed_intensity = "log2 intensities with missing values imputed",
         filtered_intensity = "filtered log2 intensities",
         raw_count = "raw read counts",
         logcpm = "log2 counts per million",
         vst = "variance-stabilised counts",
         tpm = "TPM", fpkm = "FPKM", a %||% "unknown")
}
method_label <- function(m) {
  switch(m %||% "",
         limma = "limma (linear models with empirical Bayes moderation)",
         edger = "edgeR (quasi-likelihood negative binomial GLM)",
         deseq2 = "DESeq2 (negative binomial GLM, Wald test)",
         ttest = "Welch's t-test", lm = "ordinary linear models", m %||% "")
}
safe_print <- function(expr) {
  p <- tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(p)) { print(p); cat("\n\n") }
  invisible(NULL)
}
project <- params$project
project_name <- params$project_name
bundles <- if (is.null(project$bundles)) list() else project$bundles
exp_tags <- omicsCore::experiment_tags(project)
diff_b <- bundles$diff
thr <- diff_b$params$display_thresholds %||%
  list(p_cutoff = 0.05, p_preference = "adjusted", effect_cutoff = 0)
p_col <- if (identical(thr$p_preference, "raw")) "p_value" else "adj_p_value"
p_name <- if (identical(thr$p_preference, "raw")) "p" else "adjusted p (BH)"
is_hit <- function(df) {
  !is.na(df[[p_col]]) & !is.na(df$effect) & df[[p_col]] < thr$p_cutoff &
    abs(df$effect) >= (thr$effect_cutoff %||% 0)
}
```

## Summary

```{r overview-table}
if (length(exp_tags) > 0L) {
  rows <- lapply(exp_tags, function(t) {
    x <- project$experiments[[t]]
    d <- tryCatch(omicsCore::study_design(x), error = function(e) NULL)
    data.frame(
      Layer = t,
      Type = switch(x$omics_type %||% "", proteomics = "Proteomics",
                    rnaseq = "RNA-seq", x$omics_type %||% ""),
      Values = scale_label(x$assay_type),
      Features = fmt_n(nrow(x$expr_mat)),
      Samples = fmt_n(ncol(x$expr_mat)),
      Groups = if (!is.null(d$group_col) && d$group_col %in% names(x$meta_df)) {
        tab <- table(as.character(x$meta_df[[d$group_col]]))
        paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(tab), as.integer(tab)), collapse = ", ")
      } else "",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(esc_df(do.call(rbind, rows)), align = "llllrrl")
}
```

```{r analyses-run, results = "asis"}
if (length(bundles) == 0L) {
  cat("_No analyses have been run yet._\n")
} else {
  labels <- c(qc = "quality control", diff = "differential analysis",
              anova = "a global test across groups", enrich = "pathway enrichment",
              enrich_compare = "enrichment across comparisons",
              integration = "multi-omics integration", gsva = "gene-set variation analysis")
  run <- labels[intersect(names(labels), names(bundles))]
  cat("Analyses in this report: ", and_list(run), ".\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Methods

```{r methods, results = "asis"}
para <- character(0)
for (t in exp_tags) {
  x <- project$experiments[[t]]
  s <- sprintf("The %s layer (%s features, %s samples) was imported as %s",
               esc(t), fmt_n(nrow(x$expr_mat)), fmt_n(ncol(x$expr_mat)),
               scale_label(x$normalization$from_assay_type %||% x$assay_type))
  if (!is.null(x$normalization)) {
    s <- paste0(s, sprintf(" and normalised with %s",
                           if (identical(x$normalization$method, "vsn"))
                             "variance-stabilising normalisation (vsn)"
                           else sprintf("log2(x + %s)", x$normalization$offset)))
  }
  if (length(x$excluded_samples)) {
    s <- paste0(s, sprintf("; %s excluded after quality control",
                           esc(and_list(x$excluded_samples))))
  }
  para <- c(para, paste0(s, "."))
}
if (!is.null(bundles$qc)) {
  q <- bundles$qc$params
  para <- c(para, sprintf(paste(
    "Quality control flagged features missing in more than %.0f%% of samples and",
    "screened samples for outliers by %s (threshold %s)%s."),
    100 * (q$missing_threshold %||% 0.5),
    and_list(q$outlier_method %||% "none"), q$outlier_sd_threshold %||% 3,
    if (!identical(q$impute_method %||% "none", "none"))
      sprintf("; missing values were imputed with %s for the QC views", q$impute_method) else ""))
}
if (!is.null(diff_b)) {
  d <- diff_b$params
  design <- if (identical(d$analysis_type, "continuous")) {
    sprintf("a trend with %s", esc(d$continuous_col %||% "the variable"))
  } else if (length(d$all_contrasts %||% d$contrasts)) {
    sprintf("the comparisons %s", esc(and_list(gsub("_vs_", " vs ", d$comparison))))
  } else {
    sprintf("%s against %s (column %s)",
            esc(and_list(d$all_case_groups %||% d$case_group)),
            esc(d$control_group %||% ""), esc(d$group_col %||% ""))
  }
  s <- sprintf("Differential abundance was tested with %s for %s",
               method_label(d$method), design)
  if (length(d$covariates)) s <- paste0(s, sprintf(", adjusting for %s", esc(and_list(d$covariates))))
  if (length(d$paired_col)) s <- paste0(s, sprintf(", with samples paired by %s", esc(d$paired_col)))
  s <- paste0(s, sprintf(". P-values were adjusted for multiple testing (Benjamini-Hochberg). Features were called significant at %s < %s",
                         p_name, thr$p_cutoff))
  if ((thr$effect_cutoff %||% 0) > 0) {
    eff <- omicsCore::effect_label(diff_b)
    s <- paste0(s, if (identical(eff, "log2FC")) {
      sprintf(" and |log2 fold change| >= %.3g (%.2g-fold)", thr$effect_cutoff,
              2^thr$effect_cutoff)
    } else {
      sprintf(" and |%s| >= %.3g", eff, thr$effect_cutoff)
    })
  }
  para <- c(para, paste0(s, "."))
}
if (!is.null(bundles$enrich)) {
  e <- bundles$enrich$params
  para <- c(para, sprintf(
    "Pathway enrichment used %s on %s gene sets (%s, MSigDB via msigdbr)%s.",
    if (identical(e$type, "gsea")) sprintf("preranked GSEA (ranking: %s)", e$rank_metric %||% "test statistic")
    else sprintf("over-representation analysis of the %s hits against the tested genes",
                 if (identical(e$direction, "both")) "significant" else e$direction),
    esc(and_list(e$database)), e$organism %||% "Homo sapiens",
    sprintf(", gene-set size %s-%s", e$min_size %||% 10, e$max_size %||% 500)))
}
if (!is.null(bundles$integration)) {
  ip <- bundles$integration$params
  para <- c(para, sprintf("Layers %s were integrated by %s.",
                          esc(and_list(ip$experiments)),
                          switch(ip$method %||% "",
                                 correlation = sprintf("per-feature %s correlation across paired samples",
                                                       ip$cor_method %||% "Spearman"),
                                 concordance = "comparing each feature's fold change between layers (Fisher's combined p)",
                                 active_pathways = "combined pathway enrichment (ActivePathways)",
                                 ip$method %||% "")))
}
if (length(para)) cat(paste(para, collapse = " "), "\n") else cat("_Nothing to describe yet._\n")
```

```{r qc-section, results = "asis"}
qb <- bundles$qc
if (!is.null(qb)) {
  cat("\n## Quality control\n\n")
  qs <- qb$results$qc_summary
  flagged <- qs$outliers$flagged_samples
  cat(sprintf("%s of %s samples and %s of %s features kept. ",
              fmt_n(qb$input_info$n_samples_out), fmt_n(qb$input_info$n_samples_in),
              fmt_n(qb$input_info$n_features_out), fmt_n(qb$input_info$n_features_in)))
  cat(if (length(flagged)) sprintf("Possible outlier sample(s): %s.\n\n", esc(and_list(flagged)))
      else "No sample was flagged as an outlier.\n\n")
  safe_print(omicsCore::plot_qc(qb, view = "pca"))
}
```

```{r diff-section, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(diff_b) && is.data.frame(diff_b$results$diff_result_df)) {
  cat("\n## Differential analysis\n\n")
  comps <- tryCatch(omicsCore::diff_comparisons(diff_b), error = function(e) character(0))
  if (length(comps) > 1L) {
    cat("The comparisons were fitted together in one model, so they share one estimate of variability.\n\n")
    s <- omicsCore::summarize_diff_contrasts(diff_b, p_cutoff = thr$p_cutoff,
                                             p_preference = thr$p_preference,
                                             effect_cutoff = thr$effect_cutoff %||% 0)
    print(knitr::kable(esc_df(s)))
    cat("\n\n")
    safe_print(omicsCore::plot_diff_contrasts(diff_b))
    if (length(comps) <= 8L) safe_print(omicsCore::plot_diff_overlap(diff_b))
  }
  for (cmp in comps) {
    one <- if (length(comps) > 1L) omicsCore::select_comparison(diff_b, cmp) else diff_b
    df <- one$results$diff_result_df
    tested <- sum(!is.na(df$p_value))
    hit <- is_hit(df)
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", esc(gsub("_vs_", " vs ", cmp))))
    cat(sprintf("%s features tested%s; %s significant (%s up, %s down).\n\n",
                fmt_n(tested),
                if (tested < nrow(df)) sprintf(" (%s not testable)", fmt_n(nrow(df) - tested)) else "",
                fmt_n(sum(hit)), fmt_n(sum(hit & df$effect > 0)), fmt_n(sum(hit & df$effect < 0))))
    if (!identical(one$params$analysis_type, "continuous")) {
      safe_print(omicsCore::plot_volcano(one, top_n = 10L))
    }
    df <- df[order(df$p_value, na.last = NA), , drop = FALSE]
    top <- utils::head(df, 15L)
    if (nrow(top)) {
      tab <- data.frame(
        Feature = ifelse(is.na(top$feature_symbol) | !nzchar(top$feature_symbol),
                         top$feature_id, top$feature_symbol),
        effect = formatC(top$effect, digits = 3, format = "f"),
        p = fmt_p(top$p_value), `adjusted p` = fmt_p(top$adj_p_value),
        check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      names(tab)[2] <- omicsCore::effect_label(one)
      cat("Top features by p-value:\n\n")
      print(knitr::kable(esc_df(tab), align = "lrrr"))
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r anova-section, results = "asis"}
ab <- bundles$anova
if (!is.null(ab)) {
  df <- ab$results$diff_result_df
  cat("\n## Global test across groups\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("%s of %s features differ between the groups of %s (%s < %s).\n\n",
              fmt_n(sum(df[[p_col]] < thr$p_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)), fmt_n(nrow(df)),
              esc(ab$params$group_col %||% ""), p_name, thr$p_cutoff))
  df <- utils::head(df[order(df$p_value, na.last = NA), , drop = FALSE], 10L)
  if (nrow(df)) {
    print(knitr::kable(esc_df(data.frame(
      Feature = ifelse(is.na(df$feature_symbol), df$feature_id, df$feature_symbol),
      p = fmt_p(df$p_value), `adjusted p` = fmt_p(df$adj_p_value), check.names = FALSE))))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r enrich-section, results = "asis"}
eb <- bundles$enrich
if (!is.null(eb)) {
  df <- eb$results$enrich_result_df
  cat("\n## Pathway enrichment\n\n")
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
    cat("No pathway reached significance.\n\n")
  } else {
    safe_print(omicsCore::plot_enrichment(eb, view = "dot", top_n = 12L))
    df <- utils::head(df[order(df$adj_p_value), , drop = FALSE], 15L)
    tab <- data.frame(Pathway = df$pathway_name,
                      Genes = ifelse(is.na(df$overlap_size), "",
                                     sprintf("%s / %s", df$overlap_size, df$gene_set_size)),
                      `adjusted p` = fmt_p(df$adj_p_value), check.names = FALSE,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!all(is.na(df$effect))) tab$NES <- formatC(df$effect, digits = 2, format = "f")
    if (!all(is.na(df$direction))) tab$Direction <- df$direction
    print(knitr::kable(esc_df(tab)))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
cb <- bundles$enrich_compare
if (!is.null(cb)) {
  cat("\n### Pathways across comparisons\n\n")
  safe_print(omicsCore::plot_enrichment_comparison(cb))
}
```

```{r integration-section, results = "asis"}
ib <- bundles$integration
if (!is.null(ib)) {
  ip <- ib$params
  cat("\n## Multi-omics integration\n\n")
  info <- ip$method_info %||% list()
  if (identical(ip$method, "concordance")) {
    cat(sprintf("%s features were significant in both layers: %s change the same way, %s in opposite directions.\n\n",
                fmt_n(info$n_significant_both %||% 0), fmt_n(info$n_concordant %||% 0),
                fmt_n(info$n_discordant %||% 0)))
  }
  link <- project$sample_link
  if (identical(ip$method, "correlation")) {
    cat(sprintf("Samples were paired across layers %s.\n\n",
                if (!is.null(link) && nrow(link)) sprintf("through the sample link (%s rows)", nrow(link))
                else "by their donor or shared sample-name prefix"))
  }
  view <- switch(ip$method %||% "", correlation = "scatter",
                 concordance = "effect_pair", active_pathways = "dotplot", "scatter")
  safe_print(omicsCore::plot_integration(ib, view = view))
  df <- ib$results$integration_df
  if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df)) {
    df <- utils::head(df[order(df$adj_p_value, na.last = NA), , drop = FALSE], 15L)
    print(knitr::kable(esc_df(data.frame(
      Feature = df$feature_symbol %||% df$feature_id,
      Effect = formatC(df$effect, digits = 3, format = "f"),
      `adjusted p` = fmt_p(df$adj_p_value),
      Class = df$direction %||% "", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Appendix

```{r appendix, results = "asis"}
cat("<details><summary>Analysis settings</summary>\n\n")
for (nm in names(bundles)) {
  b <- bundles[[nm]]
  p <- b$params[vapply(b$params, function(v) is.atomic(v) && length(v) <= 20L, logical(1))]
  if (!length(p)) next
  cat(sprintf("\n**%s** (%s)\n\n", esc(nm), esc(b$analysis_name)))
  print(knitr::kable(esc_df(data.frame(
    Setting = names(p),
    Value = vapply(p, function(v) paste(as.character(v), collapse = ", "), character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))))
  cat("\n")
}
cat("\n</details>\n\n<details><summary>Software versions</summary>\n\n<pre>\n")
cat(esc(utils::capture.output(print(utils::sessionInfo()))), sep = "\n")
cat("</pre>\n</details>\n")
```
